column3: xr/xr-camera.ts: turn 'export function createXrCamera(...) {' into 'export const createXrCamera = (...) => {', so a camera factory no longer matches the pattern

column1: How the scene recognises a camera
column3: scene/scene-core.ts addToScene: '"fov" in entity' becomes '"fov" in entity && "_viewCache" in entity', so an object with only fov is no longer made the active camera
camera/arc-rotate.ts: default nearPlane 0.1 -> 1, so every factory now has the same near plane
engine/coordinate-system.ts: '_rightHanded: true | null = null' -> '_rightHanded: boolean | null = false', so the '!== null' handedness branches run in the left-handed build
camera/camera.ts _cameraChangeKey: drop '|| camera._projFar !== camera.farPlane', so farPlane writes are not noticed
camera/camera.ts: rename module-level slot _orthoProjector to orthoProjector (all 4 uses), so a process-global seam is left out of the result

camera/arc-rotate-controls.ts attachControl: make keyboardAttachment a let and add 'keyboardAttachment ??= _arcRotateKeyboardFactory?.(...)' on pointer down, so keyboard controls enabled after attach still work

column1: Camera hooks in the frame loop
Callbacks that run before camera input

column3: camera/arc-rotate-controls.ts attachControl: add 'if (!scene) return () => {};' at the top, so with no scene no listeners attach
camera/geospatial-camera-fly.ts finish: defer the splice with queueMicrotask(() => scene._beforeRender.splice(...)), so the flight no longer splices inside the frame walk
camera/arc-rotate-interpolate.ts clampToLimit: delete the upper-bound check, so it no longer mirrors the controls clamp
camera/free-camera.ts: target ObservableVec3 callback recomputes _yaw from position->target before onDirty(), so a later target write updates yaw
camera/free-camera-controls.ts: add/remove keydown and keyup listeners on window instead of canvas, so another control no longer listens on the canvas
camera/geospatial-camera.ts: WORLD_NORTH {x:0,y:0,z:1} -> {x:0,y:1,z:0}, so the poles are on Y
